title: AI Disclosure Compliance Ledger
oneLiner: Small businesses prove where AI touches customers, contracts, hiring, and support before a state rule or angry customer asks.
targetUser: Owners and ops leads at small firms using AI chatbots, hiring tools, contract generators, meeting bots, or customer-service agents.
keyUx: Inventory every AI touchpoint, classify customer/employee impact, attach approved-tool status, and export a disclosure plus review packet.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app called “AI Disclosure Compliance Ledger” for small businesses using AI in customer support, hiring, contracts, and internal operations. Show an AI touchpoint inventory, customer/employee impact lanes, approved-tool checks, sensitive-data warnings, disclosure text builder, human oversight proof log, and review calendar. Design direction: use the operator-dense profile with compact compliance rows, disciplined dark-neutral surfaces, sharp status chips, tabular dates, and a serious evidence-first workflow.
